title: Where my heart lies
creator_credit: Vicki Baker, ACMI Digital Storytelling and ACMI
brief_description: Vicki Baker, mother of three, grew up in the bush but eventually had to move to town to find employment. She recalls her childhood days of family and the freedom of running through the bush with the wind in her hair and not a care in the world.
